_doc: How each model was served, when not by its developers' own server. Models not listed: their own server (bench/models/<name>.sh).
bespoke-nimble-9b: JevBench shim (Nimble's own Modal server does not run locally); same request mapping as Nimble's compiler.py, PyTorch reference runner, current checkpoint
verdict: OpenJev server (razorback16/openjev), which reimplements Verdict 1.4's prompt and temperatures; Verdict ships no HTTP server
